    • Method Detail

      • pushRecord

        void pushRecord()
        Pushes a loaded record to the stack (LIFO).
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .MERKE LIFO
        • english: 
          .RESERVE LIFO

      • popRecord

        boolean popRecord()
        Pops a record from the stack (LIFO).
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .HOLE LIFO
        • english: 
          .SELECT LIFO

        Returns:
        If there was a record on the stack.

      • delete

        void delete()
        Deletes a loaded and locked record. Only master data records may be deleted.
        The record remains loaded.
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are.
        • german: 
          .LOESCHE
        • english: 
          .DELETE
